about_short_description.short_description: Tilt (formerly Empower) is a financial technology company on a mission to expand access to fair credit.

product.name: Cash Advance
product.description: A service providing short-term cash loans ranging from $10 to $400, subject to eligibility and credit approval.

product.name: Thrive Line of Credit
product.description: A revolving line of credit that helps users build credit by making monthly payments reported to credit bureaus.

product.name: Empower AutoSave Account
product.description: An automated savings account that transfers funds from a linked bank account to help users build savings over time.
